style: Ultra realistic professional travel photograph, shot on full-frame camera, 24mm lens, natural light, rich vivid autumn colors, crisp detail, high dynamic range, cinematic, vertical 9:16 composition. Absolutely no people, no text, no letters, no signs with writing

items.name: a-aerial
items.prompt: Drone view looking straight down at a steep forested mountain valley near Kyoto in autumn, a narrow clear river winding through the gorge, mountainside covered in red, orange and yellow maple trees mixed with dark green cedar, a small traditional Japanese temple with grey tiled roofs nestled on the slope

items.name: b-steps
items.prompt: A long, steep, old mossy stone stairway climbing up a mountain to a Japanese temple, completely covered by a tunnel of brilliant red and orange Japanese maple trees, fallen red leaves on the stone steps, warm morning sunlight shining through the leaves, soft haze

items.name: c-kondo
items.prompt: A large old wooden Japanese Buddhist temple main hall with a sweeping grey tiled hip roof, standing at the top of stone steps on a mountain, framed by bright red maple branches in the foreground, clear blue sky, sunny autumn day

items.name: d-canopy
items.prompt: Looking straight up into a canopy of Japanese maple leaves glowing red, orange and gold, backlit by the sun, sun star peeking through the branches, dark curved branches, extremely vivid and luminous

items.name: e-valley
items.prompt: Golden hour view from a mountain temple viewpoint over a deep valley of autumn forest in Kyoto, layers of red and orange maple covered mountains fading into warm sunset haze, a small wooden fence railing in the foreground

items.name: f-river
items.prompt: A traditional wooden Japanese riverside teahouse with red parasols and red felt benches beside a clear mountain stream, surrounded by red maple trees, warm paper lanterns glowing at dusk, blue hour sky, calm and cozy
